text:
Aisha: heads up — noticed a customer report where the console shows provisional token charges > confirmed after a streaming reconnect + tool-call retry. Repro steps incoming.

Tom: ugh. any traces? request ids?

Aisha: here's a snippet from their debug bundle (sanitized):
```
req_id=cli-83a2
path=/v1/generate/stream
model=redwood-4b-quant
events=[stream_start, chunk(104), chunk(120), reconnect, resume_chunk(80), tool_call(start), tool_call(truncate), retry(tool_call, id=rc-7), stream_end]
provisional_tokens=304
confirmed_tokens=188
```

Ravi: looks like the tool_call retry flowed through the fallback route which trimmed the suffix. Are we double-attributing the trimmed suffix from the first stream session + the retry? :thinking_face:

Sasha: that matches something I saw in the canary last week. The router hands off to a compat variant that emits a `truncated_toolcall` event but the accounting path treats `truncated_toolcall` as a chargeable terminal fragment and then the retry emits a regular `toolcall` charge again.

Tom: can we tie attribution to a canonical final-ack event? e.g., only count tokens when we receive `session_confirm` or `stream_eof` for that session id. Currently we count on both `chunk` and `toolcall` events which overlap.

Ravi: that's the internal API debate — some infra paths (esp fallback -> compat) don't produce a clean `stream_eof` because the connection is torn before the new session attaches. We then mark provisional credits and expect a settle/confirm later. The console UX shows provisional immediately which is fine, but the settle step is missing in these edge cases.

Sasha: proposal: add two fields to telemetry/ledger events: `provisional: true|false` and `origin_session_id`. Then ledger dedupe rule: only reconcile confirmed charges by (origin_session_id, token_range_end) so retries that start a new session without claiming the same origin won't double-count.

Aisha: can we add a short-term mitigator in the console? show a badge on per-route rows: "Tentative" with hover text: "Includes provisional charges pending final ack — may be adjusted in 1-5m". That would reduce Ops panic.

Tom: agree on UI. For backend change, would prefer a strict rule: provisional credits auto-expire after TTL unless a matching confirm arrives. But TTL must be long enough to cover benign reconnects (say 2m). Otherwise refunds create churn.

Ravi: TTL + origin_session_id sounds sensible. Also, for toolcalls specifically we should record `toolcall_attempt_id` and `toolcall_finalized` boolean. Example event payload: 
```json
{
  "event": "toolcall_charge",
  "attempt_id": "rc-7",
  "origin_session_id": "s-1931",
  "tokens": 116,
  "provisional": true
}
```
When `toolcall_finalized=true` or when we receive `session_confirm` for `s-1931` we flip to confirmed or refund duplicates.

Sasha: implementation note — router currently throws away `origin_session_id` on handoff because of an internal types mismatch. I'll push a small compatibility shim to pass it through. Might be 1-2 days.

deploy-bot: deploy/canary finished for infra/router-shim @redwood-eng (commit e3b9f2) :white_check_mark:

Aisha: nice. after that shim we should add an integration test that simulates: connect -> send chunks -> server disconnect -> resume with new session id -> retry toolcall. Expectation: provisional shows briefly then either confirm once finalize arrives or auto-expire and refund within TTL.

Tom: also add a debug log line when we drop an origin_session_id on handoff so customers' repros get an explicit hint: `origin_session_dropped=true` with request id. That'll save hours of sleuthing.

Ravi: agree. I'll draft a small RFD for the ledger dedupe rule and the telemetry schema change. Punting on refunds policy until we see telemetry (how often this happens).

Sasha: for console UX I'll mock up two visuals: (1) per-route tentative indicator, (2) per-request hover shows provisional vs confirmed tokens with timeline. Will post screenshots.

Aisha: thanks team. TL;DR: shim to preserve origin_session_id, emit provisional flag + attempt id for toolcalls, TTL for provisional credits, UI badge to avoid panic. Follow-ups: RFD from Ravi, UX mock from Sasha, integration test from Tom.

Tom: assigning follow-ups: @Ravi take RFD, @Sasha mock UX, @Tom add tests + console tooltip copy. I'll pick this up tomorrow during infra hours.

Aisha: thanks — I'll reply when I get the customer's sanitized bundle. :thumbsup:
